offering_description.value: Operates a franchise network of independent insurance agencies that help individuals and small businesses shop and buy auto, home, life and commercial coverage from multiple carriers, earning commissions when policies are placed.

primary_services.value: insurance brokerage; personal auto and home coverage placement; life insurance placement; commercial insurance placement

customer_segment.value: B2C: households buying personal auto, home, renters and life insurance; B2B: small and mid-sized businesses buying commercial insurance

end_markets.value: personal insurance; small business insurance; life and financial protection

revenue_model.value: commissions or management fees: carrier commissions paid when customers buy policies placed by its agencies; other: royalties and fees paid by franchisees that operate the agency locations

value_chain_position.value: service provider: places insurance coverage and advises customers, sold to households and businesses; distributor: sells insurance carriers' policies through its franchised agencies to consumers and businesses

geography_served.value: US national: nationwide across the United States through franchised agency locations

specialization.value: related lines: personal auto, home, life and commercial insurance lines sharing customers and agency channels

distribution_channels.value: direct sales: agents selling coverage by phone and in person to customers; online: online quote and purchase of insurance coverage; other: franchised independent agency locations operated by franchisees

regulatory_exposure.value: high: state insurance producer licenses required to sell policies, regulated by state departments of insurance
